profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built ETL pipelines to deliver ESG data to the enterprise data lake using a distributed message queue system. 

Designed and orchestrated asynchronous, parallel job execution to support end-to-end workflows including request processing (on-demand and scheduled), data delivery, and status tracking.

Led the development of a self-service data ingestion platform that enables users to configure ingestion pipelines, automate data publishing, and visually monitor progress through a web-based interface.

Developed client-facing data delivery solutions leveraging distributed queue-based orchestration to ensure scalable, reliable, and trackable data distribution workflows.

positions.title: Advisor
positions.description: Served as an industry advisor for the Cornell Tech Product Studio in Fall 2024, guiding a project exploring how an AI-powered voice assistant could help visually impaired individuals navigate NYC streets.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led agile-driven engineering consulting projects focused on digital transformation within the AEC industry across multidisciplinary teams.

Built an automated workflow to prune and optimize complex architectural 3D geometry, enabling BIM models to be energy simulation ready.

Applied NLP-based text analytics to map project opportunities to UN SDGs, supporting strategic investment decisions.

Developed a map-based content management system capable of retrieving geospatial data and visualizing data points on an interactive indoor map.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed firm-wide design automation tools using the Autodesk Revit API in C#, streamlining modeling workflows and documentation across Building Information Modeling (BIM) projects. 

Implemented generative design solutions by creating a rule-based geometric system with formalized parameters to enhance design consistency and efficiency.

Resolved interoperability challenges across multiple 3D architectural modeling platforms by establishing a centralized “single source of truth” supported by a relational database, enabling smoother collaboration and coordinated delivery.

positions.description:
